title: Multiple standing waves of Helmholtz equation with mixed dispersion concentrating in the high frequency limit
summary: In this paper, we study the nonlinear Helmholtz equation with mixed dispersion \begin{equation*} Δ^2 u-βk^2\, Δu+αk^4 u=W(x)\, |u|^{p-2}u~\text{in}~\mathbb{R}^N, \end{equation*} where the weight function $W(x)$ is continuous, nonnegative, and satisfies \[ \limsup_{|x|\to\infty} W(x) \; 0$, $β<-2\sqrtα$; \qquad (c) $α=0$, $β<0$, \end{center} After a suitable rescaling, we obtain the existence of dual ground state solutions, which concentrate along the global maximizers of $W$ as $k\to\infty$.
